$comment: Allowed @pwp/* imports per package (ADR 0001). Owner: architect. tenants/ may import nothing.
ADR 0002 Enforcement (a) and (f), issue #79. The rich-text chokepoint: only code in allowedIn may turn Markdown into HTML.
(a) Code under scan (packages/**, playground/**) outside allowedIn may not import restrictedImports (globs over the package name; remark and rehype are the bundles of the remark-*/rehype-* families),
may not import astro:content (its render() is Astro's own Markdown path; tenant content is loaded by the CLI),
may not use <Content />, and may not import .md/.mdx files (including import.meta.glob of Markdown).
(f) bannedTokens may not appear in any text file in the repo (outside node_modules, .git and build output), allowedIn included.
bannedTokenExceptions lists the only files that may name them: the ADR that bans them and this config.
Changing or weakening any of this needs security approval and an update to ADR 0002.
